q1_cleanup_planning.question: Does P3 solve user-visible cleanup planning?
q1_cleanup_planning.answer: YES — PLAN mode provides preview of keep/delete/confirm with sizes. All modes generate reports. User sees what will happen before any action.

q2_manual.question: What remains manual?
q2_manual.answer: User must explicitly choose mode and confirm destructive actions. 2-step DELETE (PLAN → CONFIRM). --ForceEvidence for CORE_EVIDENCE deletion. No auto-cleanup.

q3_delete_safe.question: Is destructive delete safe to expose?
q3_delete_safe.answer: YES with safeguards: PLAN preview required, --Confirm required, CORE_EVIDENCE preserved by default, --ForceEvidence for full deletion, CONTEXT SPACE ONLY (never touches real project files).

q4_staging.question: Should cleanup be integrated into staging pack?
q4_staging.answer: YES — PACK-STAGING-P8 should integrate Memory Quality P2 (minimal ingestion) + P3 (retention cleanup) into the staging bundle.

q5_next.question: Recommended next?
q5_next.answer: PACK-STAGING-P8 (integrate P2+P3 into staging) OR return to AB-0-R2 for release evidence. Memory quality pipeline (P2→P3) is internally complete.

q6_v05.question: Does v0.5 remain blocked?
q6_v05.answer: YES — v0.5 remains BLOCKED. Memory quality is internal optimization. 3 CRITICAL/HIGH blockers still active.
